claims.statement: The Options sidebar navigation is GHES-only. Its screenshot caption is not image inspection, an observed menu, verified permission or a changed setting.

The Role dropdown next to a username or team selects the desired package permission level. The fragment does not enumerate roles or establish an authorized identity, actual assignment or effective access; no grant was changed.

The Deleted selection in Select versions view filters the package-version list. A view selection is not restoration, proof that versions are recoverable or a complete deleted-version census; the screenshot itself was not inspected.

The pinned usage description says public packages are free and private packages have plan-dependent included storage and transfer, with excess controlled by budgets. No numeric allowance, present price, actual budget, unlimited private usage or cost authorization follows; no billing settings were inspected or modified.

The note describes classic PAT authentication support for GitHub Packages. Read alongside tranche 255's explicit Actions GITHUB_TOKEN paths, it must not be generalized into denial of workflow tokens or support for fine-grained PATs. The linked token guide remains separate review work; no token was created or used.

The GHES-only pinned note excludes clustering support for GitHub Packages. This is a historical capability constraint, not current live topology discovery, denial for every deployment model or approval to reconfigure an enterprise.
